name: Link
description: Native anchor for navigation. Visible content owns the accessible name while hover, active, and focus presentation remain browser-derived from the live Figma state axis.

props.name: children
props.description: Required visible link content and normal accessible-name source.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native anchor element and interaction surface.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible link content rendered with semantic small-label typography.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer hover rendered with CSS; not a public state prop.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus presentation derived from browser focus-visible state.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Active pointer/keyboard presentation rendered with CSS; not a public state prop.

semantics.accessibleName: Visible children provide the normal accessible name; consumers may forward native aria-* attributes when product context requires them.
semantics.keyboardActivation: native anchor activation when href is present
requirements: Navigational Link examples provide an href so the element has native link semantics.
Native anchor attributes including href, target, rel, download, and aria-* are forwarded unchanged.
Browser hover, active, and focus-visible states are derived in CSS with no JavaScript state machine.
No disabled, visited, icon, size, or loading component API exists in version 1.0.0.
